title: Peec AI Review 2026: Pricing, Features, Limits
summary: Peec AI review for 2026: plans from $95 to $495, what a prompt really costs, what it tracks well, and why it does not write the pages that win the prompt.
body_markdown:
**Peec AI is the best pure AI visibility tracker for SEO teams in 2026** : clean data, daily runs, unlimited seats, and plans from $95 a month. It is also, by its own description, not a content-generation tool. Peec tells you where ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI answers leave you out. Fixing that is still your job.


## The verdict


- **Buy Peec if** you have an SEO lead and writers, and the missing piece is trustworthy data on which prompts you win and lose.
- **Skip Peec if** nobody on the team will turn its findings into pages. A tracker without a writer is a dashboard.
- **The alternative that fixes it:**[Sprites](https://www.sprites.ai/alternatives/peec-ai) tracks the same engines, then writes and publishes the page that wins the prompt. Free to start.


Peec AI’s pricing for brands, September 21, 2026: three self-serve plans and a custom Enterprise tier.


## What Peec AI is


Peec AI is a Berlin company founded in 2025 that tracks how brands appear in AI answers. It raised a seed round led by 20VC in July 2025 and a $21M Series A led by Singular in November 2025, opened a New York office in 2026, and says more than 3,000 brands and agencies use it, Zalando, Attio, Squarespace, n8n and Wix among them.


You give Peec a list of buyer prompts. It runs them every day on the AI models you pick and records whether your brand appears, in what position, with what sentiment, next to which competitors, and which sources the engine cited. That is the whole product, and it does it well.

### What a prompt actually costs you


The plan names count prompts, but the meter is answers. Each prompt runs on each model every day, so the number that matters is prompts × models × days.


Starter’s 50 prompts on three models are 4,500 answers a month. The Advanced plan’s 350 prompts are 31,500.


## What Peec AI does well


- **Clean core metrics.** Visibility, average position, sentiment and share of voice per prompt, per model, per day.
- **Source analytics.** Which domains and URLs each engine cited, with citation share and the query fan-outs behind an answer. This is the most actionable part of the product.
- **Discovery.** Prompt volume estimates, prompt and competitor suggestions, personas and bulk import.
- **New in 2026.** AI Shopping analytics at SKU level (June), Brand Perception for attributes and objections (August), and a view of sponsored placements inside ChatGPT.
- **Access.** Unlimited seats on every plan, Looker Studio on Advanced, CSV exports, and API and MCP access.


Peec AI’s own quickstart: setting up a workspace, prompts and competitors.


## Where Peec AI stops


Peec lists what it is not on its own site: “Not a content-generation tool (by design)”. Its Act features, gap analysis and recommended actions, point at the work. Doing the work is outside the product.


- **No writing, no publishing.** When Peec shows a rival owning “best project management tool for agencies” in Perplexity, the answer-first page, the comparison table and the FAQ schema that would win it are for your team to produce.
- **Three models per plan.** Covering ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews and AI Mode together means add-ons or Enterprise.
- **API and SSO are Enterprise-only.** Fine for most teams, a blocker for some.
- **Nothing on the paid side.** A prompt you are losing is also a keyword you could buy while the page ranks. Peec has no view of your ads.


The AEO category as one pipeline. The question for every tool is where its bar stops, and what you do by hand after that.


## What the answer engines say about Peec AI


On September 21, 2026, the[Sprites AEO grader](https://www.sprites.ai/tools/aeo-grader) gave Peec AI an F, 33 out of 100. ChatGPT placed it next to UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Zapier, reading the name as an automation company. Gemini had nothing to say about it. Only Perplexity, the most citation-driven of the three, knew Peec as an AI visibility tool and listed it next to Profound, AthenaHQ and Otterly.


Peec AI’s own AEO grade. Answer engines are non-deterministic, so treat one run as a snapshot, but the lesson holds: tracking visibility does not create it.

## Who should buy Peec AI


- **Yes:** in-house SEO teams and agencies with writers, multi-market brands (countries are free), teams that want unlimited seats on a small budget.
- **No:** founders and one-person marketing teams, teams that need every engine at once on a self-serve plan, and anyone who wants the work done rather than reported.


## Peec AI review: frequently asked questions


### How much does Peec AI cost?


Peec AI costs $95 a month on Starter (50 prompts), $245 on Pro (150 prompts) and $495 on Advanced (350 prompts), each with three AI models of your choice, unlimited users and daily tracking. Enterprise is custom and adds API access, SSO and up to 13 models. Agency plans run $245, $495 and $795 a month on credits.


### Is Peec AI worth it?


For an SEO team with writers who will act on the data, yes: Peec is the cleanest affordable AI visibility tracker, with daily runs, unlimited seats and good citation analysis. For a team without writers, it is a report nobody acts on, because Peec does not write or publish content. That team is better served by a tool that fixes the gap, such as Sprites.


### What counts as a prompt in Peec AI?


A prompt is one question you track, such as “best CRM for startups”. Peec runs it on each of your models every day, and each run is one AI answer. Monthly answers are prompts × models × days, so Starter’s 50 prompts on three models is 4,500 answers a month. Prompts can be shared across projects.


### Which AI models does Peec AI track?


Every self-serve plan lets you choose three models from a list that includes ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity. More models, including Claude, Grok, DeepSeek and Mistral, are sold as add-ons or included on Enterprise, which tracks up to 13.


### Does Peec AI write content?


No. Peec describes itself as not a content-generation tool, by design. It shows where you are missing, which sources the engines cite and which actions to take, but writing and publishing the pages is left to your team. Sprites is the alternative that tracks the same engines and then writes and publishes the fix.


### Does Peec AI have a free trial?


Yes. Peec offers a free trial on its self-serve plans without asking for a card; it does not publish the trial length. Enterprise starts with a sales call.


### What is the best Peec AI alternative?


Sprites, if you want the gap fixed rather than charted: it tracks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI surfaces, then writes and publishes the page that wins the prompt, and it is free to start. Otterly is the cheaper pure tracker, and Profound is the enterprise option.
